choices.why: Reads the weather device your Home Assistant already has. Stays on your home network. Needs Home Assistant set up for Jarvis on the PC.

choices.label: Open-Meteo (online)
choices.why: Free, no key. Sends your rough position (about 11 km) to api.open-meteo.com about every 20 minutes while a face is showing - nothing else. Turning it on takes an approval card; turning it off is instant.
